name: Morrow Shepherd
lore: A gentle keeper of the forgotten. Fallen ordinary enemies leave grave markers for 25s. Raise their echoes as temporary allies. Bosses cannot be raised. Summons grant no extra kill XP.

primary.name: Gravespark
primary.description: A pale spirit dart that stops at the first foe or wall.

secondary.name: Raise Remains
secondary.description: Aim at grave markers within a 140-radius area. Raise up to two melee echoes, 42 HP each, for 18s. Each deals 10 damage every 1.2s. Corpses are consumed.

special.name: Life Lattice
special.description: For 7s, share remaining health with your echoes. Red links steal up to 6 HP/s from crossing foes. At the end, reserve 60% of remaining health for you, 40% for echoes, capped by each maximum. Area attacks can hit several linked bodies.

passive: Grave Chorus: Raise a third, ranged echo and increase each echo to 60 HP. The ranged echo deals 8 damage every 1.2s.

technique.name: Wide Vigil
technique.description: Raise from a 210-radius area instead of 140, but cooldown becomes 12s instead of 9.

final_technique.name: Last Procession
final_technique.description: Replace shared health with a final march. Echoes rush the aimed spot, burst for 24 damage each and slow nearby foes, then fade.

attack.name: Last Procession
attack.description: Send your echoes to an aimed point. Each bursts in an 80-radius area and slows for 1.5s, consuming the echo.
